summary: Iteration 46 — validated Apify listings → permanent products bridge. All 11 backend tests pass (11/11 = 100%). Confirmed: (1) products catalog now has >=165 items with sku populated (Amazon ASINs), (2) POST /api/admin/products/import-from-listings is idempotent (second call returns created=0 and total unchanged), (3) auth guards enforced (401/403 without token, 403 for non-admin sophia_style), (4) MongoDB products collection has zero TTL indexes, (5) single product GET returns all required fields, invalid id → 404, (6) Apify webhook still 200s and reports created/updated, (7) canonical 10 categories intact, listings & products both populated → NO DB_NAME regression.
critical_code_review_comments: Bridge endpoint POST /api/admin/products/import-from-listings behaves correctly with idempotent upsert on sku=apify_asin — verified across two consecutive calls.

DB_NAME env var currently set to 'merchari_global' (per test_credentials.md) — this is the intended value with real data. Note: it is a typo-shaped word ('merchari' vs 'mercari') — safe as long as memory/test_credentials.md keeps it as source of truth. Any refactor that 'fixes' the spelling to mercari_global would break the connection to the populated DB.
products.list_indexes contains no expireAfterSeconds — persistence guaranteed.
No image URL validation observed in bridge results; recommend a follow-up audit of product image URLs for broken/expired links.
